features.title: Pair a phone over a self-provisioned HTTPS tunnel
features.summary: Opt-in public phone access: a persisted setting decides whether DSH exposes the pairing gateway, the chosen provider provisions the tunnel, and startup prints a one-time QR plus 6-digit code. Redemption issues a persistent per-device cookie; the gateway proxies to the loopback native listener with its own exchanged cookie and rewrites Host/Origin.
features.currentSurface: host: terminal QR plus loopback gateway
failureModes: Nothing is published until settings.json enables phone access; the disabled startup only prints the enable path and detected providers.
A missing tunnel provider or unusable native cookie reports on the terminal and never exposes the native listener.
An expired, reused or rate-limited pairing attempt is refused without issuing a device.
Revocation stops new requests for that cookie but does not yet drop sockets already open.

externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Tunnel startup is injectable through the loopback gateway tests; no provider is invoked there.
